name: paint-stroke
about: Four strokes across a blank 1080p canvas with the brush named in `brush`, each 70% of the width in 1.5 s at 120 events a second — the gesture behind every drawing-latency report. Measures the UI cost of each pointer batch (stroke.move), how long ink took to reach the screen (pen.screen, tip.screen), each live pass of a textured or simulated brush (live.pass) and how many points behind the pen it landed (live.behind), and the pen-up commit (stroke.commit). Run it with --brush builtin-ink:60 as the control; the four rows stay apart so a wet brush does not re-wet its own last stroke.
